verses.en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
verses.pt: No ano terceiro do reinado do rei Belsazar apareceu-me uma visão, a mim, Daniel, depois daquela que me apareceu no princípio.
verses.en_web: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
verses.en_bbe: In the third year of the rule of Belshazzar the king, a vision was seen by me, Daniel, after the one I saw at first.

verses.en: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
verses.pt: E na visão que tive, parecia-me que eu estava na cidadela de Susã, na província de Elão; e conforme a visão, eu estava junto ao rio Ulai.
verses.en_web: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw in the vision; and when I saw it, I was in the strong town Shushan, which is in the country of Elam; and in the vision I was by the water-door of the Ulai.

verses.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.pt: Levantei os olhos, e olhei, e eis que estava em pé diante do rio um carneiro, que tinha dois chifres; e os dois chifres eram altos; mas um era mais alto do que o outro, e o mais alto subiu por último.
verses.en_web: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns. The two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up my eyes, I saw, there before the stream, a male sheep with two horns: and the two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, the higher one coming up last.

verses.en: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
verses.pt: Vi que o carneiro dava marradas para o ocidente, e para o norte e para o sul; e nenhum dos animais lhe podia resistir, nem havia quem pudesse livrar-se do seu poder; ele, porém, fazia conforme a sua vontade, e se engrandecia.
verses.en_web: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.
verses.en_bbe: I saw the sheep pushing to the west and to the north and to the south; and no beasts were able to keep their place before him, and no one was able to get people out of his power; but he did whatever his pleasure was and made himself great.

verses.en: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
verses.pt: E, estando eu considerando, eis que um bode vinha do ocidente sobre a face de toda a terra, mas sem tocar no chão; e aquele bode tinha um chifre notável entre os olhos.
verses.en_web: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
verses.en_bbe: And while I was giving thought to this, I saw a he-goat coming from the west over the face of all the earth without touching the earth: and the he-goat had a great horn between his eyes.

verses.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
verses.pt: E dirigiu-se ao carneiro que tinha os dois chifres, ao qual eu tinha visto em pé diante do rio, e correu contra ele no furor da sua força.
verses.en_web: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.
verses.en_bbe: And he came to the two-horned sheep which I saw before the stream, rushing at him in the heat of his power.

verses.en: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.pt: Vi-o chegar perto do carneiro; e, movido de cólera contra ele, o feriu, e lhe quebrou os dois chifres; não havia força no carneiro para lhe resistir, e o bode o lançou por terra, e o pisou aos pés; também não havia quem pudesse livrar o carneiro do seu poder.
verses.en_web: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground, and trampled on him. There was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw him come right up to the sheep, and he was moved with wrath against him, attacking the sheep so that his two horns were broken; and the sheep had not strength to keep his place before him, but was pushed down on the earth and crushed under his feet: and there was no one to get the sheep out of his power.

verses.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.pt: O bode, pois, se engrandeceu sobremaneira; e estando ele forte, aquele grande chifre foi quebrado, e no seu lugar outros quatro também notáveis nasceram para os quatro ventos do céu.
verses.en_web: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: And the he-goat became very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken, and in its place came up four other horns turned to the four winds of heaven.

verses.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
verses.pt: Ainda de um deles saiu um chifre pequeno, o qual cresceu muito para o sul, e para o oriente, e para a terra formosa;
verses.en_web: Out of one of them came out a little horn, which grew exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.
verses.en_bbe: And out of one of them came another horn, a little one, which became very great, stretching to the south and to the east and to the beautiful land.

verses.en: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
verses.pt: e se engrandeceu até o exército do céu; e lançou por terra algumas das estrelas desse exército, e as pisou.
verses.en_web: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground, and trampled on them.
verses.en_bbe: And it became great, even as high as the army of heaven, pulling down some of the army, even of the stars, to the earth and crushing them under its feet.

verses.en: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.pt: Sim, ele se engrandeceu até o príncipe do exército; e lhe tirou o holocausto contínuo, e o lugar do seu santuário foi deitado abaixo.
verses.en_web: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.en_bbe: It made itself great, even as great as the lord of the army; and by it the regular burned offering was taken away, and the place overturned and the holy place made waste.

verses.en: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
verses.pt: E o exército lhe foi entregue, juntamente com o holocausto contínuo, por causa da transgressão; lançou a verdade por terra; e fez o que era do seu agrado, e prosperou.
verses.en_web: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.
verses.en_bbe: ... against the regular burned offering; and ... crushed down to the earth, and it did its pleasure and things went well for it.

verses.en: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
verses.pt: Depois ouvi um santo que falava; e disse outro santo àquele que falava: Até quando durará a visão relativamente ao holocausto contínuo e à transgressão assoladora, e à entrega do santuário e do exército, para serem pisados?
verses.en_web: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”
verses.en_bbe: Then there came to my ears the voice of a holy one talking; and another holy one said to that certain one who was talking, How long will the vision be while the regular burned offering is taken away, and the unclean thing causing fear is put up, and the holy place crushed under foot?

verses.en: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
verses.pt: Ele me respondeu: Até duas mil e trezentas tardes e manhãs; então o santuário será purificado.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, For two thousand, three hundred evenings and mornings; then the holy place will be made clean.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
verses.pt: Havendo eu, Daniel, tido a visão, procurei entendê-la, e eis que se me apresentou como que uma semelhança de homem.
verses.en_web: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me something like the appearance of a man.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when I, Daniel, had seen this vision, I had a desire for the sense of it to be unfolded; and I saw one before me in the form of a man.

verses.en: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
verses.pt: E ouvi uma voz de homem entre as margens do Ulai, a qual gritou, e disse: Gabriel, faze que este homem entenda a visão.
verses.en_web: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”
verses.en_bbe: And the voice of a man came to my ears between the sides of the Ulai, crying out and saying, Gabriel, make the vision clear to this man.

verses.en: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, perto de onde eu estava; e vindo ele, fiquei amedrontado, e caí com o rosto em terra. Mas ele me disse: Entende, filho do homem, pois esta visão se refere ao tempo do fim.
verses.en_web: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man; for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”
verses.en_bbe: So he came and took his place near where I was; and when he came, I was full of fear and went down on my face: but he said to me, Let it be clear to you, O son of man; for the vision has to do with the time of the end.

verses.en: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.pt: Ora, enquanto ele falava comigo, caí num profundo sono, com o rosto em terra; ele, porém, me tocou, e me pôs em pé.
verses.en_web: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.en_bbe: Now while he was talking to me, I went into a deep sleep with my face to the earth: but touching me, he put me on my feet where I had been.

verses.en: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
verses.pt: e disse: Eis que te farei saber o que há de acontecer no último tempo da ira; pois isso pertence ao determinado tempo do fim.
verses.en_web: He said, “Behold, I will make you know what will be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, See, I will make clear to you what is to come in the later time of the wrath: for it has to do with the fixed time of the end.

verses.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.pt: Aquele carneiro que viste, o qual tinha dois chifres, são estes os reis da Média e da Pérsia.
verses.en_web: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.en_bbe: The sheep which you saw with two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.pt: Mas o bode peludo é o rei da Grécia; e o grande chifre que tinha entre os olhos é o primeiro rei.
verses.en_web: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.en_bbe: And the he-goat is the king of Greece: and the great horn between his eyes is the first king.

verses.en: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
verses.pt: O ter sido quebrado, levantando-se quatro em lugar dele, significa que quatro reinos se levantarão da mesma nação, porém não com a força dele.
verses.en_web: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.
verses.en_bbe: And as for that which was broken, in place of which four came up, four kingdoms will come up from his nation, but not with his power.

verses.en: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
verses.pt: Mas, no fim do reinado deles, quando os transgressores tiverem chegado ao cúmulo, levantar-se-á um rei, feroz de semblante e que entende enigmas.
verses.en_web: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding dark sentences, will stand up.
verses.en_bbe: And in the later years of their kingdom, when their evil doings have become complete, there will come up a king full of pride and expert in dark sayings.

verses.en: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
verses.pt: Grande será o seu poder, mas não de si mesmo; e destruirá terrivelmente, e prosperará, e fará o que lhe aprouver; e destruirá os poderosos e o povo santo.
verses.en_web: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.
verses.en_bbe: And his power will be great, and he will be purposing strange things. And all will go well for him and he will do his pleasure; and he will send destruction on the strong ones.

verses.en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
verses.pt: Pela sua sutileza fará prosperar o engano na sua mão; no seu coração se engrandecerá, e destruirá a muitos que vivem em segurança; e se levantará contra o príncipe dos príncipes; mas será quebrado sem intervir mão de homem.
verses.en_web: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken without hand.
verses.en_bbe: And his designs will be turned against the holy people, causing deceit to do well in his hand; in his heart he will make himself great, and send destruction on numbers who are living unconscious of their danger; and he will put himself up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken, though not by men's hands.

verses.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
verses.pt: E a visão da tarde e da manhã, que foi dita, é verdadeira. Tu, porém, cerra a visão, porque se refere a dias mui distantes.
verses.en_web: “The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.”
verses.en_bbe: And the vision of evenings and mornings which has been talked of is true: and keep the vision secret; for it has to do with the far-off future.

verses.en: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
verses.pt: E eu, Daniel, desmaiei, e estive enfermo alguns dias; então me levantei e tratei dos negócios do rei. E espantei-me acerca da visão, pois não havia quem a entendesse.
verses.en_web: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up, and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.
verses.en_bbe: And I, Daniel, was ill for some days; then I got up and did the king's business: and I was full of wonder at the vision, but no one was able to give the sense of it.
